args: go telemetry off && [ "$(go telemetry)" = "off" ] || { echo "Failed to disable Go telemetry"; exit 1; }
xx-apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends             gcc             libc6-dev             linux-libc-dev             pkg-config

set -ex
  CC=$(xx-info)-gcc cmake .
  make tini-static
  xx-verify --static tini-static
  mkdir /build
  mv tini-static /build/docker-init
apt-get update && xx-apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends             gcc             libc6-dev             linux-libc-dev             libseccomp-dev             pkg-config

set -e
  xx-go --wrap

  target=runc
  verify_flags=
  if [ "$DOCKER_STATIC" = "1" ]; then
    target=static
    verify_flags=--static
  fi

  set -x
  CGO_ENABLED=1 make RUNC_BUILDTAGS="-libpathrs" "$target"
  xx-verify $verify_flags runc
  mkdir /build
  mv runc /build/
apt-get update && xx-apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends             gcc             pkg-config

set -e

  make_flags=
  verify_flags=
  cgo_enabled=1
  if [ "$DOCKER_STATIC" = "1" ]; then
      make_flags=STATIC=1
      verify_flags=--static
      cgo_enabled=0
  fi

  set -x
  xx-go --wrap
  CC="$(xx-info)-gcc" CGO_ENABLED=$cgo_enabled make $make_flags binaries
  xx-verify $verify_flags bin/containerd
  xx-verify $verify_flags bin/containerd-shim-runc-v2
  xx-verify $verify_flags bin/ctr
  mkdir /build
  mv bin/containerd bin/containerd-shim-runc-v2 bin/ctr /build
apt-get update && xx-apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends             gcc             libc6-dev             linux-libc-dev             pkg-config

set -e

  if [ "$DOCKER_STATIC" = "1" ]; then
      set -x
      export CGO_ENABLED=0
      xx-go build -o /build/rootlesskit ./cmd/rootlesskit
      xx-verify --static /build/rootlesskit
  else
      set -x
      export CGO_ENABLED=1
      xx-go build -o /build/rootlesskit -ldflags='-linkmode=external' ./cmd/rootlesskit
      xx-verify /build/rootlesskit
  fi
apt-get update && apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y             clang             lld             llvm             icoutils

xx-apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y             gcc             libc6-dev             linux-libc-dev             libnftables-dev             libseccomp-dev             libsystemd-dev             pkg-config

set -ex
  # in bullseye arm64 target does not link with lld so configure it to use ld instead
  if [ "$(xx-info arch)" = "arm64" ]; then
    XX_CC_PREFER_LINKER=ld xx-clang --setup-target-triple
  fi

set -e

  target=dynbinary
  verify_flags=
  exe_suffix=
  if [ "$DOCKER_STATIC" = "1" ]; then
      target=binary
      verify_flags=--static
  fi
  if [ "$(xx-info os)" = "windows" ]; then
      exe_suffix=.exe
  fi

  set -x
  xx-go --wrap
  PKG_CONFIG=$(xx-go env PKG_CONFIG) ./hack/make.sh "$target"
  xx-verify $verify_flags "/tmp/bundles/${target}-daemon/dockerd${exe_suffix}"
  if [ "$(xx-info os)" = "linux" ]; then
      xx-verify $verify_flags "/tmp/bundles/${target}-daemon/docker-proxy"
  fi
  mkdir /build
  mv /tmp/bundles/${target}-daemon/* /build/
